date_scope_check.qualification_retained:
NA003-R1: The 1 August 2018 onset is retained with explicit source priority: a contemporary 14 August account of Melilla’s government declaration dates implementation to 1 August, and the Spanish government’s indexed parliamentary response says it learned of and sought confirmation of the measure that day. Later 30 August press-conference reports instead describe closure since 31 July; the one-day discrepancy remains recorded, without displacing the more directly documented implementation date or inventing a notice/effect distinction.

The Moroccan spokesperson attributed the measure to developing Nador port commerce; this does not establish every motive or justify an inferred sovereignty-dispute purpose. The first documented experimental export crossed from Melilla to Morocco at approximately 13:30 on 27 January 2023. This scoped endpoint does not establish unrestricted, full-day or bilateral commercial restoration. Passenger passage remains outside this phase. Reports based on the same government statement are not independent corroboration.
